privacy.ai_training_note: Grammarly can use customer data to train AI models by default for Free/Premium/Pro tiers. OFF by default for Enterprise, Business, and Education tiers. Users can disable via Product Improvement and Training control in account settings. Grammarly restricts third-party AI service providers from training on customer content.

products.name: Grammarly Free
products.data_scope: User writing content for grammar/clarity checks
products.notes: AI training enabled by default. Basic writing features. No cost.

products.name: Grammarly Premium
products.data_scope: User writing content including tone and style suggestions
products.notes: AI training enabled by default. Advanced suggestions, tone detection, plagiarism checker.

products.name: Grammarly Pro
products.data_scope: User writing content with team collaboration
products.notes: AI training ON by default for single-user and web-purchased plans; OFF by default for Sales-team purchases. Generative AI features, style guides, team collaboration.

products.name: Grammarly Enterprise
products.data_scope: Organization writing content with confidential mode option
products.notes: AI training OFF by default. Confidential mode, granular permissions, data loss prevention, unlimited users, dedicated support.

products.name: Superhuman Go
products.notes: Part of Superhuman Platform acquisition. Productivity agents for docs and workflows.

products.name: Grammarly for Education
products.notes: AI training OFF by default for all education accounts.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (Free tier + Premium monthly/yearly + Pro + Enterprise contact sales)
compare.data_residency: US East (AWS) with international transfer capability. DPA available for enterprise.

flags: Grammarly has been acquired by and merged into Superhuman Platform Inc. Privacy policy and DPA inquiries now redirect to the Superhuman domain; verify the ongoing separation of product tiers.

Consumer Free, Premium, and Pro tiers have AI training enabled by default. While opt-out is clearly available, this differs from the Enterprise posture, where training is off by default, so tier selection matters during procurement.
Primary infrastructure runs in AWS US East. While DPA compliance is stated, EU/UK users should confirm data localization requirements.
HIPAA compliance is conditional on executing a Business Associate Agreement. It is not a default feature; users must request and execute the agreement.
